title: lastlook normalized campaign
description: The contract between an adapter and the engine. An adapter's only job is to emit this shape; render and check never learn which platform produced it. Write a new adapter against this file, not against another adapter.

schema_version.description: Bumped only on a breaking change to this shape.

platform.description: Where this came from: instantly, heyreach, csv, fixture, ...

defined_vars.description: Variables the PLATFORM says exist. Null when the platform has no registry (HeyReach, CSV). Null vs empty matters: null disables the undefined-tag check rather than reporting every tag as undefined.

delay_days.description: Days to wait AFTER this step before the next one. Null when the platform does not state it — null disables the pacing check rather than being treated as zero.

limits.description: Hard character caps for this channel, e.g. {"body": 300} for a LinkedIn connection note.

subject.description: Empty on a follow-up means the platform threads it under the first email.

body.description: May contain HTML; the renderer strips tags and decodes entities.

signal.description: The angle this variant tests, if the platform tracks one.

fallbacks.description: Per-variant fallback map. Inline {{var | fallback}} in the body takes precedence over this.

email.description: Null is legitimate on a LinkedIn campaign; the list-hygiene rules skip those.

payload.description: Custom variables. Keys are matched case-insensitively and across snake/camel, so first_name and firstName both resolve.

handoffs.description: Cross-platform jumps, e.g. a HeyReach step that pushes the lead into an Instantly campaign.
